generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can self-certify by omitting a risk family, exercising only sibling producers, or attaching numeric claims without exact-subject execution evidence.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Generate internally consistent audit JSON whose declared families and passed controls never independently rederive source obligations or exercise every material producer/evidence boundary.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: source-rederived risk plus discriminant producer and exact-subject evidence closure
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Derive minimum risk families and semantic identity surfaces from canonical source text before implementation; require exact-subject quantitative provenance whenever the contract contains executed numeric criteria.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Reject handoff when a rederived family is absent, a semantic identity control lacks deliberately divergent fields at persistence, an inherited control lacks exact-head discriminant observation, or numeric evidence lacks a matching subject hash.

transfer_cases.scenario: A webhook delivery is replayed after process restart with the same durable event key, then replayed with a divergent payload.
A producer receives deliberately different product, version and subscription identities and must preserve each one at the storage boundary.
A percentile claim is regenerated after a material code change and the previous measurement is rejected as stale.

skill_changes.change: Canonical source inference now activates duplicate-processing and semantic identity propagation before freeze.
Final gates require discriminant inherited controls and exact-material-head quantitative evidence provenance.
